source_issues.finding: Convexity does not ensure existence, unique minimizer, arbitrary descent convergence or no step-size selection. Nonconvex problems are not uniformly impossible and neural methods have alternatives; source single-valley rhetoric retained.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: Ball versus circle/sphere boundary is ambiguous in source examples. Hessian criterion needs twice differentiable function on convex domain; arbitrary finite point sampling is not proof. Affine a^T x+b is called linear in source; translation does not silently adjust.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: All neural networks/any loss nonconvex and nonlinear hidden layers always break convexity are broad structural generalizations with degenerate/special cases. LASSO and SVM description depends on objective/parameterization; original qualifiers kept.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: Hessian sign at a point alone does not identify a local extremum without stationarity; zero Hessian eigenvalue does not imply truly flat higher-order behavior. PSD eigenvalue definition assumes appropriate symmetric matrix. Source remains unchanged.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: Newton quadratic-model minimizer needs positive-definite nonsingular Hessian; local quadratic convergence has smoothness/start conditions and error constants. Global damping/line search may be needed. Invariance is not arbitrary nonlinear reparameterization, and quadratic exactness presumes nonsingular model.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: Lagrange method yields constrained stationarity/saddle conditions, not simple joint unconstrained minimization in x and lambda; gradient-regularity conditions matter. Doc code actually descends x and ascends lambda. Example solution(.5,.5),lambda=-1 verified independently.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: KKT necessity needs constraint qualifications; an active constraint can have zero multiplier, so source active(lambda>0) equivalence is incomplete. Complementarity permits both constraint value and multiplier zero. Translation final table correctly makes never-both-nonzero refer to g and lambda, consistent with protected formula.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: Penalty/constraint equivalence requires suitable solution/duality correspondence and selected lambda/t; not every optimum touches boundary or L1 corner, and L2 can have zero coordinates. Source geometric simplifications retained.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: Convexity alone does not universally ensure strong duality; Slater condition appears correctly in later key term. Dual function generally uses inf, not necessarily attained min. Source SVM dual is hard-margin separable case; not every SVM is solved only in dual form.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: Good-minima, smooth overparameterized landscape, 2^(-n) saddle probability and sharp-overfit/flat-generalize claims need model/randomness/parameterization assumptions; not universal high-dimensional geometry. Source claims preserved without endorsement.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: L-BFGS uses displacement-gradient secant pairs, not only recent gradient differences. Approximate parameter-count ceiling and never-in-deep-learning statement are source generalizations.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: Fisher under regularity equals negative expected log-likelihood Hessian, not positive expected Hessian as source states. K-FAC block Kronecker approximation is simplified; exact source sign not silently repaired.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: Hessian-vector cost is relative to objective evaluation/AD graph, not universally O(n). Adam second moment is not generally Hessian diagonal approximation. K-FAC memory/inversion costs depend on layer shapes, so O(n) source row is not universal.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: Empirical convexity checker can miss violations; Newton code checks pre-update gradient after update, recording a redundant zero update; convergence counts depend on lr/tolerance. Doc quadratic converges to zero on first update and specified Lagrange demo converges, but this is finite evidence only.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: SciPy/sklearn production snippets require external libraries and undefined data fixtures; not executed by reviewer. Choice of first/second-order solver and good-local-minimum sufficiency are source heuristics.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair

source_issues.finding: Exercises preserved entirely without added answers. Rosenbrock point comparison depends on the exact source convention, and condition number uses positive-definite Hessian context. Further-reading links/titles retained, not browsed or treated as new evidence.
source_issues.disposition: source meaning retained; no required translation repair
